artifacts.summary: Research on relocating --meta/--review/--dream distill sub-modes to core: confirms events-query.sh and related core anchors already exist, but surfaces two cross-extension dependency gaps (Overlap Scoring formula, three-strikes threshold citation), a telemetry-guardrails.md shared-ownership question, a /review command naming collision, a /meta command overlap opportunity, and a stale quoted cross-reference, all with live-data verification.

memory_candidates.content: When a file's spec says to 'follow X by name, do not restate or fork it' as a cross-reference discipline, always trace the reference to its actual defining section before relocating the citing file across an extension boundary — the cited section may itself only be a sibling citation of a deeper canonical source elsewhere (e.g. a three-strikes threshold cited from a sub-mode spec traced back to a contracts/convergence.md precedent), and the correct fix after relocation is often to repoint at that deeper source rather than duplicate the sibling.

events-query.sh (and likely other agent-system scripts resolving PROJECT_ROOT from BASH_SOURCE[0]) refuses to run directly from the source store (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/), with a clear error directing to the deployed .claude/scripts/ copy instead. Always invoke the deployed copy when verifying source-store script behavior live, not the source-store path.
